pages.title: Weapon Types
pages.text: $(mod_name) features three weapon types, each available across multiple metal tiers:$(li2)$(item)Sword$() — Longer attack reach.$(li2)$(item)Dagger (Short Sword)$() — Higher attack speed. $(thing)1.5x damage to passive mobs$().$(li2)$(item)Hammer$() — Heavy. $(thing)1.5x damage to skeletons$().$(br2)Tiers: Copper / Silver / Gold → Iron → Mithril → Adamantium.

pages.title: Silver — Undead's Bane
pages.text: $(item)Silver weapons$() deal $(thing)1.25 / 1.5x damage$() to all undead, and grant $(thing)5s Regeneration II$() on kill.$(br2)Excellent against zombies, skeletons, and Underworld undead.
Solid mid-game weapon & tool with good durability.
Mithril-tier — significant boost to damage and durability, crafted on Diamond Crafting Table.
Adamantium alloy — extremely high durability, crafted on Netherite Crafting Table.
